sentences: In this story from the Apocrypha, the widow Judith slips into the tent of Holofernes, the general besieging her city, and cuts off his head.
Her maid pins down the struggling man with her whole body, while Judith, sleeves rolled up, grips his hair in one hand and the sword in the other.
Out of the darkness, all the arms converge on the centre and lead the eye straight to the blade.
Artemisia had painted the subject before, and in this second version the blood spurts from the neck in clean arcs.
Some historians link those arcs to the studies of motion by Galileo, who was her friend and correspondent.
The price was agreed with Grand Duke Cosimo II de' Medici, though she was paid only after a long delay, and the canvas now hangs in the Uffizi alongside works by Caravaggio.
